12月16号下午六点，燕京的天空已经完全黑了。燕京车站距离医学科学院不远，带着行李过去用不了二十分钟。寒风呼啸，路上自行车大军如流水般从刘济民身旁驶过。
燕京车站楼体亮着灯光，跟别处比，车站广场热闹多了。扛着行李赶车的、送行的人挤在一块，乌泱泱的，一不留神就撞在别人身上了。
被褥用背带绑了个标准的三横两竖背在刘济民身上。
除此之外，还有一大包个人用品和买的礼物，杨波帮忙提着提着，梁满囤和李卫国两人提着一个背包，里面装的是刘振国和王爱梅腌的咸菜和买的酱菜，楚红跟朱霖跟在旁边。
“到了部队上，一定要拍封电报过来报个平安。”王爱梅交代道，同时又询问有没有忘带的东西。
刘济民看着絮絮叨叨的王爱梅，笑着说道：“妈，你都说好几遍了！”
“嘿！你别嫌烦，等你妈蹬腿儿了，想找人烦你，也找不到了。”
刘济民笑道：“别说丧气话，您长命百岁呢！”
“放心回部队，你妈我照顾着呢！”刘振国道。
站台上，刘振国拍了拍刘济民的肩膀，语重心长地说道：“一定记得多写信！”
楚红扯着朱霖的手，在旁边别有深意地笑道：“也记得给我们写信，我们等着看呢！”
“保重！”杨波用拳头锤了锤刘济民的胸口，笑容带着牵强。
李卫国和梁满囤都笑着让刘济民保重，及时来信。
刘济民跟刘振国和王爱梅聊了几句家常，接着转身跟杨波等人依次握手，拥抱告别。
“朱霖同学，再会！”刘济民紧紧握住了朱霖的手，接着上前来照例来了一个拥抱。
朱霖发丝上的香味涌入鼻腔，隐隐牵动着刘济民的血液。凑得再近一点，还能闻到体香和雪花膏混合而成的香味。
“记得给我写信！”刘济民轻声说道，温热的气息挠得朱霖耳朵痒痒的。
“嗯，我会的，你也是。”
站台上人影穿梭，光线时亮时暗，没人发现朱霖脸上的异样。
这趟列车燕京站是始发站，六点四十五左右，刘济民接过大包小包，随着人流挤上了火车。站台上的众人随着刘济民的身影，一路跟到了硬卧所在车厢。

At six o'clock in the afternoon on December 16, the sky in Yanjing was completely dark. Yanjing Station is not far from the Academy of Medical Sciences, and it takes less than twenty minutes to get there with your luggage. The cold wind howled, and the army of bicycles passed by Liu Jimin like flowing water on the road.
The Yanjing Station building was lit up, and the station square was much more lively than elsewhere. People carrying luggage and driving, and people seeing off people were crowded together, and it was so noisy that if you didn't pay attention, you would bump into others.
The quilt was tied with straps in a standard pattern of three horizontally and two vertically and placed on Liu Jimin's back.
In addition, there was a large bag of personal items and purchased gifts. Yang Bo helped carry it, while Liang Mandun and Li Weiguo carried a backpack containing pickles pickled by Liu Zhenguo and Wang Aimei and the pickles they bought. Chu Hong and Zhu Lin followed beside them.
"When you get to the army, you must send a telegram to report that you are safe." Wang Aimei explained, and at the same time asked if there was anything forgotten.
Liu Jimin looked at the nagging Wang Aimei and said with a smile: "Mom, you have said it several times!"
"Hey! Don't be annoyed. When your mother kicks her legs, I want to find someone to annoy you, but I can't find anyone."
Liu Jimin smiled and said: "Don't say such depressing words, you will live a long life!"
"Don't worry, go back to the army, I'll take care of your mother!" Liu Zhenguo said.
On the platform, Liu Zhenguo patted Liu Jimin on the shoulder and said sincerely: "Remember to write more letters!"
Chu Hong took Zhu Lin's hand and smiled meaningfully beside her: "Remember to write us a letter, we'll wait and see!"
"Take care!" Yang Bo hammered Liu Jimin's chest with his fist, smiling forcefully.
Li Weiguo and Liang Mandun both smiled and asked Liu Jimin to take care and write in time.
Liu Jimin chatted a few words about home affairs with Liu Zhenguo and Wang Aimei, then turned around and shook hands with Yang Bo and others in turn, hugged and said goodbye.
"Goodbye, classmate Zhu Lin!" Liu Jimin held Zhu Lin's hand tightly, then came forward and gave him a hug as usual.
The fragrance from Zhu Lin's hair poured into his nose, faintly touching Liu Jimin's blood. If you get closer, you can still smell the scent of deodorant mixed with cream.
"Remember to write to me!" Liu Jimin said softly, his warm breath tickling Zhu Lin's ears.
"Yeah, I can, and so can you."
People were walking around on the platform, the light was bright and dark, but no one noticed the strange look on Zhu Lin's face.
Yanjing Station was the departure station for this train. At about 6:45, Liu Jimin took the large and small bags and squeezed onto the train with the flow of people. Everyone on the platform followed Liu Jimin's figure all the way to the compartment where the hard sleeper was located.
